senses.gloss: m. (זָנַק) squirting, splash, water rushing through a spout.
units: <cite ref="Zevachim 25b:7">Ib.</cite> <he>במזרק שא״א לו בלא ז׳</he> when receiving the blood of the sacrifice in the bowl, which cannot be done without splashing.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 962:2">Yalk. Deut. 962</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 33:22">Deut. XXXIII, 22</cite> <he>יזנק</he>) <he>מה ז׳ זה וכ׳</he> as the jet comes from one place and divides itself in two directions.—Pl. <he>זִינּוּקִים</he>.
